text:
maria: Heads-up — NovaEdge just asked to swap demos between node lab B and C due to customs delay on their GPUs. Can we reroute demos and swag?
ben: Ugh. Which session is affected?
kai: NovaEdge session is 2:30pm room C (hands-on lab). They said freight stuck at airport.
maria: Exactly. They proposed doing a streamed demo from their cloud instance into our onsite lab (screen share + small local fallback). Need kit owners to confirm we can host 2 streaming demos simultaneously.
sam: We have 6 kits for room C. If NovaEdge goes remote we can move 3 kits to room B and run both flows. Need to update seatmap and volunteer rota.
alex: I'll update the BoothOps sheet and QR check-in routing. Quick note — we have 40 partner swag bundles for room C. If kits move, swag needs redistribution, and customs paperwork for extras.
maria: Can one of you ping HelixSI to confirm they can take the extra 3 seats? cc @HelixSI (partner) — we promised a demo-swapped run.
ben: Pinged HelixSI via DM, they can cover 3 seats but need a laptop HDMI passthrough adapter. Do we have spares?
kai: We have 2 adapters in spare kit, procurement has one more on-site. Sam can confirm.
sam: Confirmed — adapter + spare USB-C hub in locker A2. I'll label and drop at room B.
maria: Logistics for streaming fallback: set up OBS scene with the partner RTMP ingest, fallback instructions for moderators. Alex, can you add to runbook?
alex: Added section: "Remote partner live -> OBS ingest -> local AV mix -> on-stage monitor". Also included healthcheck commands:

```bash
# check RTMP stream
curl -I http://rtmp.ingest.partner/health || echo "remote down"
# local AV test
ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc=duration=5:size=1280x720:rate=30 -f null -
```

maria: Perfect. Who's moderating the NovaEdge slot if they go remote? We need someone for 5 min Q&A + to cut to recorded fallback if stream dies.
ben: I can moderate. If stream fails, cut to recorded 6-min demo from our S3 bucket. Alex, can you ensure the recording is pre-cached on the AV laptop?
alex: Will do. Recording file path added to runbook and laptop pre-cached.
maria: Swag redistribution plan: move 20 bundles to room B, keep 20 at main booth for overflow. Sam — can you coordinate with courier for last-minute label swaps?
sam: Yes. I'll print new manifests and swap labels. ETA 30m.
maria: Also, marketplace announcement sync: CloudLane (cloud marketplace partner) wanted a co-marketing call after demo. Should we keep the call?
kai: Yes — keep marketing call on calendar but update time to 4pm after the session. I'll ping KM.
ben: Quick reminder: update the speaker slide deck with new contact for HelixSI (for post-demo follow-up).
nathan-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled AV test at 13:45 in room B and C.
maria: Thanks everyone. Final checklist before 14:00: 1) Move 3 kits to B (Sam) 2) Label adapters (Sam) 3) Update runbook OBS section (Alex) 4) Moderator assigned (Ben) 5) Swag manifests printed and courier updated (Sam) 6) HelixSI confirmed (Ben) 7) Marketing call time updated (Kai). Reply when done. :white_check_mark:
